decisions.reason: The modular plant concept has a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year, fits the announced modular direction and carries sunk investment and public commitment, so management persists with it.

The mobile slow-speed shredder is close to the core offer and has its own page, though the newer 2024 slow-speed shredder line could eventually absorb it, so retirement is possible but unlikely within a year.

As the multi-model flagship central to the firm's announced modular, cleaner-technology direction, it carries the greatest investment and visible commitment, and any weak results would be attributed to a temporary market ramp-up.
The trommel screen complements the firm's shredders in mobile processing chains, is close to the established offer, and the growing firm has no reason to withdraw it.
The newly launched multi-model slow-speed shredder line has its own page and sits at the firm's core, so the recent investment and commitment make dropping it very unlikely.
The new spiral shaft screen line extends the firm's mobile screening range with several models and its own page, and as a recent investment it would be given time to prove itself.
